obligations.expected_behavior: The VDD compiler rejects an active requirement whose Acceptance is not observable.
forbidden_result: The active requirement is accepted or compiled despite non-observable Acceptance.
obligations.observable_result: Compilation returns a rejection for the active requirement and indicates that its Acceptance is not observable.
obligations.state_after: The active requirement is rejected before successful semantic compilation.
obligations.state_before: An active requirement is presented with Acceptance that is not observable.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: When an active requirement's Acceptance is not observable.

obligations.expected_behavior: The VDD compiler stops processing before making any semantic model call when deterministic source preflight fails.
forbidden_result: Any semantic model call occurs after deterministic source preflight failure.
Semantic processing continues after deterministic source preflight failure.
obligations.observable_result: Execution terminates at deterministic source preflight failure with zero semantic model calls made.
obligations.state_after: Compilation is stopped before semantic model invocation.
obligations.state_before: Deterministic source preflight has failed and semantic model invocation has not yet occurred.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler

obligations.expected_behavior: The VDD compiler returns a structured `repair-vdd` recommendation that identifies the blocking reason.
forbidden_result: No repair-vdd recommendation is returned when compilation is blocked.
The recommendation omits the blocking reason.
obligations.observable_result: The compiler response contains a structured recommendation with type or action `repair-vdd` and an explicit blocking reason.
obligations.state_after: A structured repair-vdd recommendation identifying the blocking reason is returned.
obligations.state_before: Compilation is blocked by a validation or deterministic source preflight failure.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: When compilation is blocked by the stated validation failure conditions.
